verdict.rationale: Adyen's own Disputes API lets merchants retrieve disputes, defend or accept them, and upload defense documents programmatically, so submission to the issuer can happen without manual copy-paste. Nothing in the evidence shows Adyen compiling that evidence automatically from order, delivery, or session data; the merchant would have to assemble and push it. missing for 10: automatic evidence compilation from order/delivery/session data, documented auto-submission workflow or rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, chargeback responses are automated — evidence compiled from order, delivery, and session data and submitted to the issuer without manual copy-paste

citations.quote: You can retrieve dispute information, defend or accept disputes, and upload defense documents.
